تستغثن (form X)
# تَسْتَغِثْنَ (tastaḡiṯna) /tas.ta.ɣiθ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغَاثَ (istaḡāṯa)
# تُسْتَغَثْنَ (tustaḡaṯna) /tus.ta.ɣaθ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغَاثَ (istaḡāṯa)
